tutorial.title: Tutorial fMRIPrep
tutorial.denominator: Parcel centers on the 4-mm image grid
tutorial.note: Matching fMRIPrep mask unavailable. Temporal variation is a proxy affected by masking, interpolation and int8 quantization.

archive.title: Independent SPM8 archive
archive.note: This is an independent preprocessing lineage, not the matching fMRIPrep parent. A 2-mm normalized grid is not native 2-mm acquisition resolution.

regions.name: Juxtapositional Lobule Cortex (formerly Supplementary Motor Cortex)

settings.mean_image: Arithmetic mean of all acquired frames; display-only float32 volume
settings.regional_series: Uncleaned full-run parcel means; original indices and source intensity units
settings.tutorial_support: Exact stored-code temporal variation / resampled tutorial parcel voxel centers
settings.archive_support: Known included SPM8 mask locations / all original native 2-mm atlas parcel centers, including out-of-grid locations
settings.unknown_policy: Separate known-inclusion and unknown-membership bits; never impute source mask NaNs
settings.atlas_interpolation: Nearest-neighbor; no new registration or replacement atlas
settings.fd_policy: Saved primary masks; frame zero excluded from both; additional censoring strictly FD > 0.5 mm
settings.biological_interpretation: Variation and mask overlap do not establish biological signal or denoising accuracy
